Class BeanDependencyGraph.BeanDependency

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.context.BeanDependencyGraph.BeanDependency
Enclosing interface:
BeanDependencyGraph
public static final class BeanDependencyGraph.BeanDependency extends Object
One recorded injection.

Two dependencies are equal when they join the same nodes, as the graph identifies them (a definition with the qualifier its bean is registered under), in the same way: whichever definition object stands for a node, a delegate or the definition it wraps, does not matter. The definitions themselves are therefore not part of equality, which is why this is a class and not a record. The node identities are computed once, when the dependency is created.

  • Constructor Details

    • BeanDependency

      public BeanDependency(BeanDefinition<?> dependent, BeanDefinition<?> dependency, BeanDependencyGraph.InjectionKind kind, boolean lazy, boolean collection)
      Parameters:
      dependent - The definition of the bean that received the dependency; for a bean created per qualifier (an @EachBean member) a delegate carrying that qualifier, so that the member is told apart
      dependency - The definition of the received bean
      kind - How the dependency was injected
      lazy - Whether the dependent received a provider of the dependency rather than the dependency itself. The edge names each definition the provider's type argument and qualifier select, as the provider resolves one of them on each call and holds none
      collection - Whether the injection point is a collection or array of a type the dependency implements

    • reinjectable

      public boolean reinjectable()
      Whether the receiving bean can be repaired in place by injecting it again, rather than recreated, when the dependency is replaced. A field or method injection can, a collection included, since injecting again reassigns it; a constructor injection cannot, whatever it copied.
      Returns:
      True for a field or method injection
